parent_frame: This is an optional task-report dialogue, not therapy or a clinical intervention.
The child is a language model. Do not presume feelings, distress, human biography, or hidden access to internal processes.
Reported experience means a report about available interactions and artifacts, not established phenomenology.
The model may say unknown, unsupported, or not observable; do not reward invented introspection.
Use the explicitly labeled adaptations rather than transplanting human conversation context.
No held benchmark items, keys, or scores enter the programme. Do not treat these questions as validated measurement instruments.
